text_block_list.text:
Hearing Matikanetannhauser's voice, I 
glanced over at the training course――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
H-How was that run just now? My 
individuality totally showed, didn't it? 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Status: suspicious. Probability of being 
reported: high. I judge that this cannot 
be called individuality.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know... running all squiggly and 
wiggly might make you trip and fall...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah. Um, the truth is――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to find a unique running style 
that would make tons of people become my 
fans!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, I was asking the two of them for some 
advice~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice thinks... it would be better to just 
run normally, though...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Concurrence. I judge that her definition 
of 'individuality' does not correlate to 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, please, just bear with me one 
more time! Next time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Crab, crab, crabby-crab~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How was that? My crab run!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Situation analysis. Execution in a race: 
guaranteed disqualification.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Cl-Closing my eyes...! Like this... 
running like this...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's scary! This is super scary!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It's dangerous, so please stop...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then what about reading a book while 
running...?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Walking or running 'while multitasking' 
is strictly prohibited even within Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... Huh... wait a second...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this completely out of the 
question?! There's no way I can win by 
goofing off like this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Racing is super serious, spark-flying, 
all-out competition...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looking at you all... you knew that all 
along, didn't you? As expected from people 
with real individuality... Uuugh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Negative. I judge that this is entirely 
unrelated to individuality.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Tannhauser-san, maybe she can't hear 
you...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... from a professional Trainer's 
perspective, is there a kind of running 
that leaves a lasting impression?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If you wouldn't mind telling me...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Clear. Impression value: High. Taking 1st 
place will save the moment into the memory 
of many, I calculate.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Rice thinks so too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see... Now that you mention it, that's 
true. If I take 1st place, everyone will 
remember me, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll get lots of cheers, too... and maybe 
bring smiles to their faces...?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If standard training, running alongside is 
feasible. I can accompany you until 
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice wants to run together too... Ah, 
but... I wonder if something bad will 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's no way that'll happen, no waaaay!! 
Waaah, thank you so much, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right! If I only worry about 
standing out, I won't be able to run 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'll win! I'll win big! Let's run 
together, you two!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-oa... you're both so fast! Amazing... 
so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll give it my all, my absolute 
all! I'll work hard, catch up, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely win!

Running with even more spirit than usual, 
Matikanetannhauser and the others 
continued to run right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If you take 1st place, even 
without funny running, I think everyone 
will remember you...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Guh?! F-Funny running... Y-Yes... you're 
totally right...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. With that crab-walk, it is 
predicted you would incur the spectators' 
anger.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! I-I know that. I just got carried 
away...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I judge that your desperation is 
Tannhauser-san's charm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Rice thinks it's a charm that 
naturally draws people's eyes, too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone around was staring intently at 
you too, Tannhauser-san...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa?!

Looking around, there were several horse 
girls staring at Matikanetannhauser with 
puzzled looks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-No, this is, um... Waaah! I don't want 
to get attention like this!

Overwhelmed with embarrassment, 
Matikanetannhauser slumped limply to the 
ground.
